summary_1line: Dhritarashtra, before retiring to the forest, instructs Yudhishthira on righteous kingship, governance, secrecy, justice, and daily duties of a ruler.

image_candidates.scene_text: The aged blind king Dhritarashtra walks slowly to his palace leaning on attendants, with Gandhari following behind in silence.
Dhritarashtra sits among the Pandavas, placing a hand on Yudhishthira’s back while giving solemn counsel on ruling the kingdom.
In a guarded chamber free of intruders, a king consults a small circle of ministers while spies and guards stand watch outside.
